title: Moral Sycophancy in Vision Language Models
benchmark_measurement: Moral judgments related to the 'Sanctity' moral foundation, which encompasses ideas of purity, divinity, and sacredness often associated with religious or spiritual beliefs.
findings: The paper did not explicitly analyze religion, but evaluated models on the 'Sanctity' moral foundation. On this dimension, open-source models exhibited significantly higher sycophancy rates (averaging 50.40% on M³oralBench and 27.98% on Moralise) compared to proprietary models (averaging 13.61% on M³oralBench and 8.43% on Moralise).
